status: DRAFT_NOT_FROZEN (candidates + rules skeleton; freeze requires smoke re-run under final code hash, seed conflict re-check, and user authorization; 30M line results may adjust Muon-family grids)

confirm.only_for: methods passing pilot gate; max 3 methods x 3 seeds

precision: bf16 autocast (cuda), fp32 master params/optimizer states

data.packing: [BOS]+enc+[EOS] concat; (seq+1)-windows stride seq; FROZEN-PILOT MUST re-vendor V16 doc-partition rule (normalize->sha256->train role) before freeze (gap G-3)
data.eval: development 256 docs (V16 ledger, dev-grade disclosed) for pilot; confirm uses sealed option chosen at freeze (coordinate holdout_v2 one-shot / mint holdout_v3 / dev-only downgrade)

metrics: same-token-budget endpoint NLL (primary; dev pool, token-weighted)
improvement vs best tuned Muon (paired, per-doc bootstrap)
improvement vs each available strong baseline (NorMuon/SAMuon-lite: SOURCE_BLOCKED, no comparison claimed)
true wall-clock + optimizer extra seconds (NS5 native/mix split, fp64 diagnostics split)
per-group update norms + gradient-consistency angles cos(O,g), cos(O,O_native)

gates_draft.pilot_pass: C_A or C_B beats best B_muon by >= 1e-3 NLL with CI95 entirely below 0 AND survives the low-momentum control (gain not reproduced by momentum 0.9/0.8 arms)
gates_draft.pilot_fail: no candidate beats best tuned Muon OR gain explained by momentum reduction -> close line at pilot scale
gates_draft.short_budget_clause: 32M tokens = 0.33 tok/param transient regime; pilot gains do NOT claim full-pretraining endpoint benefits; confirm layer (100-300M tokens) is the decisive test
